# arXiv Inspiration
> 中文文档

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that turns
arXiv into a personalized research-inspiration feed: on-d

emand surveys filtered
by a local interest knowledge base + LLM ranking, a settings-page UI to revie

w
and give feedback, an accumulating paper library, and full-text deep-read notes.
## Features

- **On-demand surveys** — pick weekdays (UTC+8) and arXiv categories, or run
from a session with the

`arxiv_inspiration` tool. Papers are fetched, coarse
filtered by your KB, ranked in parallel LLM ba

tches, and distilled into
per-paper recommendations (中文推荐理由/💡启发/建议行动 + English agent context).
- **S

ettings-page UI** (arXiv Inspiration card): configure categories/weekdays/
model/push preferences, l

aunch surveys, review results with bilingual
title/abstract, and give 👍/📖/👎 feedback — no auto-push,

you decide what
reaches a conversation.
- **Feedback loop** — 👍 auto-adds an interest chunk; 👎 gent

ly down-ranks
similar titles in later surveys (≤25% score penalty, single id exclusion).
Feedback al

so feeds profile evolution.
- **Paper library** — every fetched paper accumulates in
`~/.dsh-arxiv-i

nspiration/papers.jsonl` with scores, feedback, Chinese
translations, notes, and deep-read state. Se

archable (keyword + optional
semantic), browsable in the UI, and queryable by agents via
`arxiv_know

ledge_base` tool actions (`search_papers`, `get_paper`,
`add_paper`, …).
- **Deep-read notes** — rec

ommended papers can be read full-text (alphaXiv PDF
Q&A; as preferred source, local PyMuPDF map-redu

ce as fallback). Full notes
live in `~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/analyses/<id>.md` and open in a standa

lone
viewer window; cards show a 3–5 bullet Chinese summary. Agents can read and
write notes (`read_

analysis` / `write_analysis`) and attach timeline notes
(`add_note` / `list_notes`).
- **Profile evo

lution** — LLM drafts a revised research-interest profile from
your feedback history; you adopt/edit

/discard it in the UI. The plugin never
silently rewrites your profile.
- **alphaXiv assist (optiona

l)** — semantic paper discovery beyond configured
categories and cited full-text Q&A;, via your exis

ting alphaxiv MCP
credentials. Both toggles can be disabled per survey.
- **Session push** — push a

digest (user-facing, bilingual) or a paper list +
prompt (agent-facing) into any conversation you ch

t (user-facing, bilingual) or a paper list +
prompt (agent-facing) into any conversation you choose.
## Requirements

- DSH host >=0.1.5-rc.1.
- An LLM provider configured in DSH (the plugin uses the host `llm` service

and your session model selection by default; a specific provider/model can
be pinned in settings).

- Node.js >= 22.
- Optional, for PDF full-text extraction and semantic search: Python (below).

All data is stored under `~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/`. Uninstalling the plugin
does not delete it.
## Python setup (optional, recommended)

PDF deep-read and semantic search use a small Python environment. Without it
the plugin still works

— surveys, ranking, library, and notes run fine; PDF
deep-read is skipped and semantic search falls
back to keyword matching.
The recommended way is uv:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Notes:

- `pymupdf` powers PDF text extraction (`scripts/pdf_parse.py`).
- `fastembed` powers semantic searc

h (`scripts/kb_vec.py`, bge-small-en-v1.5,
ONNX, no torch). The model downloads on first use to
`~/.

dsh-arxiv-inspiration/models/`.
- System Python 3.12 with PEP 668 (externally-managed environment) r

ejects
direct `pip install` — that is why a venv via `uv` is recommended
(`python3 -m venv` may lack

`ensurepip` on macOS).
- The plugin resolves Python as: `.venv/bin/python` in its install directory

first, then `.venv/bin/python` in `~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/`, then plain
`python3` on PATH.
## alphaXiv credentials (optional)

The optional alphaXiv assist (semantic discovery + PDF Q&A; with page
citations) talks to `https://a

pi.alphaxiv.org/mcp/v1` with a Bearer token.
The plugin does **not** have a config field for it — it

reuses the token from
a locally installed alphaxiv MCP bundle, so the
credential lives in exactly o

he token from
a locally installed alphaxiv MCP bundle, so the
credential lives in exactly one place:

The plugin scans that file for a header line matching
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` and uses it as

-is. If you already run the
alphaxiv MCP bundle, the file exists and nothing to do. Otherwise create

it
manually with the same shape the bundle uses, e.g.:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Notes:

- Get a token from your alphaXiv account settings; calls to discovery/PDF
Q&A; consume your alphaXiv

assistant quota.
- The token never leaves your machine; nothing is embedded in this plugin or
its r

epo.
- No file / no token: both alphaXiv toggles degrade silently — surveys still
run, deep-read fal

ls back to local PyMuPDF extraction.
- Token cached for the host's lifetime; edit the file and resta

rt the DSH
host to pick up a new one.

Step 2 is required for CLI installs: `dsh plugin add` fetches the package, but
only a bundle listed

in `dsh.profile.bundles` has its `cordis.patch.yml`
composed into the running configuration. Install

ing from the GUI plugin market

After the restart the settings page gains an "arXiv Inspiration" section, and

## Configuration

Via the settings page (persisted to `~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/config.json`):
categories, weekdays, c

ross-list toggle, max papers per digest, LLM
provider/model, push count & prompt, research context,

Recall tuning (same page):

- **Hybrid recall** — when the filtered pool exceeds the candidate cap, a
keyword lane and a local-e

mbedding lane each rank the whole pool and are
fused with reciprocal-rank fusion, instead of keeping

only the newest N.
